How Much Water Should You Carry When You Go Hiking?
none. It is just is more to carry. Leave heavy things like food, water and extra clothing at home.
Don't forget to leave behind fire starters, shelter, communication devices too!

Fire starters are indeed very dangerous. They can combust in your pocket and give you a bad burn. Matches are too heavy to be lugging around anyway. Same with maps and a compass.

Here is another tip for enjoying yourself in the wild. Don't tell anyone where you are going. Do you want take the risk of other people crashing in on your enjoyment of the wild? Communing with nature is meant to be a solitary enjoyment.

Also when you are in the wild, try to make friends with animals. Bears, for example are not only cute but enjoy a good prank. A humorous tug on the tail can lead to a fun frolic with the furry fellows.
[Noob] Just bought a computer with Ubuntu 14.04 LTS installed. How do I preform a 'fresh' install of 16.04?
Make a bootable USB stick of the installer. Boot off USB. Follow the prompts. Answer the questions when asked. Wait.

Download this iso: http://releases.ubuntu.com/16.04/ubuntu-16.04-desktop-amd64.iso

Open your menu and search for "Startup Disk Creator" -> write the ISO to the usb.

Reboot with the usb still plugged in.

If that doesn't boot then you need to hold down a button to produce the boot media selection menu, durring the early stages of boot. This button will be specific to your computer (manufacturer) and often it will tell you durring the boot sequence. Optionally you can also boost the usb's priority in the BIOS.

OK, so now you are seeing something on the screen sepecific to ubuntu. Select the install option and follow the instructions.

You should now have a new system. This will wipe your data but you did say fresh install. If you do need to keep data write back and I'll go into more specifics.

If you already have Ubuntu on the machine, you probably don't need to do a fresh install. Just do

sudo apt-get dist-upgrade

This will migrate from 14 to 16
